canker.definition:
n. a fungal disease of woody plants that causes localized damage to the bark
n. an ulceration (especially of the lips or lining of the mouth)
v. become infected with a canker
canker.translation:
n. 溃疡, 腐蚀因素
vi. 患溃疡, 腐蚀, 溃烂
vt. 使患溃疡, 使腐蚀

canker rash.definition:
A form of scarlet fever characterized by ulcerated or
   putrid sore throat.

cankered.definition:
v become infected with a canker
v infect with a canker
cankered.translation: a. 害溃疡的, 恶性的, 恶毒的

cankering.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Canker
cankering.translation: v. 使溃疡( canker的现在分词 ); 受到腐蚀, 生黑腐病, 溃烂

cankerous.definition: s. having an ulcer or canker
cankerous.translation: a. 溃疡的, 使害溃疡的, 腐蚀的

cankers.definition:
n a fungal disease of woody plants that causes localized damage to the bark
n an ulceration (especially of the lips or lining of the mouth)
n a pernicious and malign influence that is hard to get rid of
v become infected with a canker
v infect with a canker
cankers.translation: n. （植物的）溃疡( canker的名词复数 ); （动物）耳溃疡; 腐败的影响; 腐蚀因素

cankerworm.definition: n. green caterpillar of a geometrid moth; pest of various fruit and shade trees

cankery.definition:
a. Like a canker; full of canker.
a. Surly; sore; malignant.

cankles.definition:
The area in affected female legs where the calf meets the foot in an abrupt, nontapering terminus; medical cause: adipose tissue surrounding the soleus tendon, probably congenital, worsened by weight gain and improved in appearance only by boots. From the English "calf" meaning wide portion of the lower leg, and "ankle" meaning slender joint of leg with foot.
> If I didn't have cankles, I might be able to wear those Prada loafers with my capri pants.
